title: vm2/JavaScript Sandbox Escape Patterns
description: General approach for JavaScript sandbox targets: identify the version first, then choose an escape
detail: 1) Confirm the sandbox implementation and version first (vm2? isolated-vm? quickjs?): look in package.json, error stack traces, /proc, or source leaks. 2) vm2: for < 3.9.19, use CVE-2023-37466/30547 (Proxy handler method); probe whether `require` is reachable first. 3) When require is unavailable, use a this/constructor chain: `.constructor.constructor('return process')().mainModule.require('child_process').execSync('...')`. 4) quickjs/custom eval sandboxes: try Function constructor or prototype-pollution escapes. 5) Send command output through console.log or exception channels. Principle: the version number determines the payload; do not spray blindly.
